name: i9_7a_top_floor_task_schedule_and_admission
note: Stock Top Floor entry, special-mode admission refusal for a fresh unranked player, and the stock schedule callback data. The positive battle is i9_7a_top_floor_task_battle. The asset set lacks windows/arena/mode/schedule/schedule.csb, so ArenaModeScheduleWindow cannot open on this asset set (I9-7A-SCHEDULE-CSB); the scenario asserts the data the window would read and does not claim its rendering.
steps: lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('arena') w.arena_:loadModeSchedule(function(infos) assert(#infos==2, 'vc-task-current-next-schedule-missing') for _,slot in ipairs(infos) do assert(slot.mode>=1 and slot.mode<=6, 'vc-task-invalid-mode') assert(slot.end_time>slot.start_time, 'vc-task-invalid-slot') end __vcScheduleRead=true end)
